notes: 2018_00_link.txt is the Faculty Family Policy (08/08); 2018_04_handbook_supplement.txt is a table of contents only (11/12; no policy text); 2018_05_handbook_supplement_toc_0816.txt is a table of contents only (08/16; no policy text, lists the Faculty Family Policy under Faculty Benefit Policies).

Governing document: the Faculty Family Policy (Faculty Handbook Supplement), covering full-time benefits-eligible tenured and tenure-track faculty; missing is false (The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply).

Birth parent chain: childbearing leave, one semester paid (c1; or childrearing leave c3 instead, in_lieu_of) -> disability leave for a certified pregnancy-related disability (c7, no stated length, its pay c8 within it), consecutive_after c1 -> unpaid leave after paid disability leave (c9, discretionary, no length) consecutive_after c7; FMLA 12 workweeks (c12) also_available with c1/c3 (no order stated).

Non-birth parent chain: childrearing leave, one semester paid (c3), if at least an equal partner in care, starting within 12 months, granted unless undue burden -> FMLA 12 workweeks (c12) also_available (no order stated).

The family leaves (c1-c3) keep grant proposals and student supervision and do not name research, so research continues (R4b) and the leaves are relief under R4c (Just teaching); under U3 they add no protected weeks.
Pay level of the family leaves is not stated ('Paid leave'): pay_fraction_pct left empty and the R3 full-pay-inferred flag added for sensitivity analysis.
The Faculty Family Policy says its leave 'is independent of' FMLA leave. S1's default would make FMLA concurrent with the paid leave; I coded also_available and flagged a rule gap.
Disability leave (Handbook VIII.C) states no maximum: 'the maximum disability leave with pay' is referred to but not given in any saved source.

Not components: sabbatical leave (scholarly purposes; a parent could not take it for a birth); leave without salary for professional development or special assignment (not parent-usable); military and jury service leave.

Cited but not saved: IIT Human Resources Policies and Procedures Manual (Family and Medical Leaves of Absence policy; long-term disability plan; health, life, dental, tuition, retirement details); Faculty Handbook Appendix C (Standards and Procedures for Promotion and Tenure); Faculty Handbook Section VII (cited by Appendix R for the definition of leave of absence); Faculty Handbook Section VI (faculty responsibilities); retirement Summary Plan Description; the other Supplement policies listed in the tables of contents (none parental).

Dates: the Faculty Family Policy copy is a 2015-09-15 capture of the 08/08 text; the version note says the same text was linked on 2017-12-26 and unchanged in 2021-2022 captures, so it is read as in force on 2018-02-22. Handbook sections are dated 04/2013.
